title: Knowing What You Know: A Trait Theory of Reviewer Value in Human-AI Cognitive Systems
summary: When a capable model and a human reviewer cooperate on the same decision, which human still adds value? We argue this is a question about a single cognitive trait, metacognitive calibration: the alignment between a reviewer's behavioral confidence and the actual correctness of their judgments. We develop a trait theory of reviewer value to make it precise. The theory makes five claims: value is governed by calibration rather than by activity, speed, agreement, or tenure; calibration leaves observable traces in behavioral telemetry; those traces are non-diagnostic on their own, because the fast, low-revision signature of a calibrated expert is indistinguishable from that of a confident novice until it is gated by outcomes; human calibration and a model's self-knowledge are the same construct, so the joint system should defer to whichever agent is better calibrated on each item; and individual calibration is causally identifiable only above the level of the single judgment. We ground each claim in a six-month production window of an AI-assisted accounting system (541621 reviewer events, 483 reviewers), and find that a purely behavioral expertise profile inverts the ground truth, scoring an overconfident cohort (5.2 percent correction survival) higher than genuine experts (99.2 percent); that reviewer quality is flat across tenure, so the trait is not learned on the job; and that the same calibration logic that separates good from bad reviewers, applied to the model, concentrates 92.5 percent of human effort on genuine errors. We close with the boundary the theory must respect: under majority-vote aggregation, individual causal value is unidentifiable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于元认知校准的评审者价值特质理论，以确定人机协作决策中人类评审者何时能真正增加价值。
AI.motivation: 解决在强大AI模型与人类协作决策时，如何准确识别哪个人类评审者具有实际增量价值的问题，并避免被表面行为特征误导。
AI.method: 提出评审者价值特质理论，核心衡量元认知校准（行为自信度与实际正确率的一致性），并主张人机系统应将每项任务交予校准度更高的一方进行处理。
AI.result: 基于AI辅助会计系统数据的分析表明，纯行为特征会反转真实表现（高估过度自信者）；任职时间与评审质量无关；将校准逻辑应用于模型可将92.5%的人力集中于真正错误的地方。
AI.conclusion: 人类评审者的价值取决于元认知校准而非行为表现或资历；人机协作应基于校准度进行动态任务分配，但在多数投票机制下个体的因果价值不可识别。

title: Render the Robot, Generate the World: One Video World Model Across Embodiments
summary: Predicting the consequences of an agent's actions requires modeling both the body's motion and the environment's response. Most video world models attempt to learn both from numerical actions, even though geometry and kinematics already specify the intended motion. We introduce Doppel, an embodiment-agnostic video world model conditioned on camera-aligned renderings of future body configurations and numerical action trajectories. By explicitly providing the intended motion, Doppel can focus on predicting object motion and interaction-driven changes in the environment. Rendered motion also provides a common visual interface across different embodiments and action spaces. To train on robot datasets without camera extrinsics, we recover camera poses and align rendered trajectories with recorded observations. We jointly train a single shared video backbone and conditioning adapter on eight datasets spanning eight robot and human embodiments, from single- and bimanual robot arms to a dexterous humanoid and human hands and bodies, using about 600 hours of video without embodiment labels. Across three robot-arm datasets, Doppel improves PSNR over action-only baselines by 1.00 dB on held-out trajectories and 1.20 dB under out-of-distribution evaluation, while predicting more consistent object motion. Training on all eight embodiments (Doppel-8) improves robot predictions over the three-robot model (Doppel-3) on four of six evaluation sets. Project page: https://doppelwm.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Doppel的智能体无关视频世界模型，通过显式输入预期运动的渲染来专注于预测环境变化，并在多智能体数据集上联合训练提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 传统视频世界模型试图从数值动作中同时学习身体运动和环境响应，但这忽略了几何和运动学已经隐含的预期运动信息，导致模型难以聚焦于环境变化预测，且难以在不同智能体间泛化。
AI.method: 提出Doppel模型，以相机对齐的未来身体配置渲染和数值动作轨迹作为条件。通过恢复相机位姿对齐渲染轨迹，在8个涵盖不同机器人和人类智能体的数据集上（约600小时无标签视频）联合训练单一视频骨干网络和条件适配器。
AI.result: 在三个机械臂数据集上，相较于仅使用动作的基线，Doppel在留出轨迹上的PSNR提高了1.00 dB，在分布外评估中提高了1.20 dB，且物体运动预测更一致；在8个智能体上联合训练的模型在六个评估集中的四个上优于仅在三个机器人上训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式提供预期运动，模型能更专注于环境交互预测，从而提升预测精度和一致性；且跨多个不同智能体的联合训练有助于提升机器人的预测泛化能力。

title: Agentic Harness Engineering Beta: Requirement-Centered Evolution of Agent Harnesses
summary: Real-world harness engineering is driven by explicit and implicit user requirements, which guide development and validation. However, existing harness evolution methods often overlook implicit requirements and interaction needs, while using a single evolution agent to modify the harness and benchmark scores to select changes. This process often produces narrow patches and leads to benchmark-specific local optima. We introduce Agentic Harness Engineering Beta (AHE-Beta), a requirement-centered loop that brings real-world engineering practices into harness evolution. The loop consists of three steps: (1) User-driven evaluation lets simulated users raise their requirements as issues while they work with the harness over multiple turns. (2) Team-based modification implements those requirements as generalizable changes rather than task-specific patches. (3) Requirement-driven selection merges a change only when it resolves a verified requirement and passes review. Empirically, on held-out tasks, AHE-Beta raises pass@1 from 21.9% to 33.3% while using 40.8% fewer tokens than Base Harness, and achieves higher pass@1 than Claude Code, Meta-Harness, and AHE. In a blind human A/B test, real users prefer AHE-Beta in 31 of 48 valid pairs and rate it higher on all five dimensions, matching the directional preference of the user simulator. The human A/B results show that AHE-Beta achieves its goal of aligning harness evolution with real-world user requirements. Without further evolution, the gains transfer to GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with pass@1 improvements of 15.8% and 5.3% over Base Harness. Together, these results show that requirement-centered harness evolution is a more general method for improving agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种以需求为中心的测试框架演化方法AHE-Beta，通过模拟用户评估、团队式修改和需求驱动选择三步循环，显著提升了智能体的泛化能力与用户满意度。
AI.motivation: 现有测试框架演化方法往往忽略隐式需求与交互需求，且依赖单一演化代理和基准分数选择修改，容易导致补丁过于狭窄并陷入基准特有的局部最优。
AI.method: 提出AHE-Beta，采取需求中心式循环：模拟用户通过多轮交互提出需求，团队式修改将需求实现为可泛化的变更，需求驱动选择仅在变更通过验证和审核时才合并。
AI.result: 在留出任务上pass@1从21.9%提升至33.3%，token使用减少40.8%，优于Claude Code等基线；盲测A/B中48对有效对里31对偏好AHE-Beta；无进一步演化时增益可迁移至GLM-5.3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，分别提升15.8%和5.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以需求为中心的测试框架演化更符合真实世界工程实践，能更通用、更有效地提升智能体能力，并具备良好的跨模型迁移性。

title: PrismRestore: A Compact Restoration Toolbox for Agentic Image Restoration
summary: Agentic image restoration composes operations to handle mixed degradations, yet its toolbox often requires storing multiple restoration networks. We propose PrismRestore, which constructs a compact bank of callable restoration actions from a single frozen all-in-one model. Our approach builds on task-dependent yet overlapping channel responses in the shared model. An offline task-prior search uses activation and gradient statistics to group channels with similar response profiles, then searches task-specific modulation coefficients over non-representative channels while leaving representative channels unmodulated. The resulting prior bank enables explicit action selection and composition without additional restoration backbones or task-specific adapter modules. A state-conditioned policy learns to compose these actions using Group Relative Policy Optimization. Its objective separately normalizes fidelity and perceptual feedback within groups of trajectories sampled for the same input, and combines terminal evaluation with return-to-go derived from stepwise quality changes. Experiments on synthetic composite-degradation and real-world multi-task benchmarks show improvements over the evaluated all-in-one baselines and restoration quality competitive with multi-model agents. PrismRestore achieves these results with a single restoration backbone and faster inference than the evaluated agentic baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PrismRestore，基于单一冻结模型构建紧凑可调用操作库，实现高效推理的智能体图像恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体图像恢复工具箱需存储多个恢复网络，导致资源冗余和推理延迟。论文旨在解决如何在避免多模型开销的前提下，有效处理混合退化问题。
AI.method: PrismRestore利用单一冻结的all-in-one模型，通过离线任务先验搜索，利用激活和梯度统计将具有相似响应特征的通道分组。搜索策略仅对非代表性通道进行任务特定调制，结合状态条件策略与组相对策略优化(GRPO)学习动作组合。
AI.result: 在合成复合退化和真实多任务基准测试中，PrismRestore优于评估的all-in-one基线方法，恢复质量与多模型智能体系统相当，且在推理速度上更快。
AI.conclusion: PrismRestore证明了利用单个恢复主干网络构建紧凑操作库的可行性，为高效图像恢复提供了新范式，未来可探索在更多视觉任务中的应用。

title: On Evaluating User Simulators for Interactive Agents
summary: User simulators offer a scalable way to evaluate interactive agents, but how to assess their quality remains underexplored. In particular, it is unclear whether existing user simulator evaluation frameworks reliably detect meaningful failures in simulated user behavior. This uncertainty makes it difficult to interpret simulator evaluation. To understand what a high benchmark score tells us about simulator quality, we (meta-)evaluate the metrics themselves. To instantiate this meta-evaluation, we deliberately perturb simulated replays to induce failures such as altered goals, omitted constraints, premature stopping, and acceptance of broken work, then test whether the metrics penalize these failures. Evaluation methods from three prior studies detect only 5-6 of the 10 perturbations; their combined scores even favor populations instructed to accept broken work over unmodified controls. Motivated by these gaps, we propose a new evaluation suite that combines utility of user simulators for evaluating agents and two measures of fidelity to real users: population-level fidelity assesses collective interaction patterns, while trace-level fidelity assesses the preservation of individual users' goals, constraints, and persona. Under the same detection criterion, our evaluation suite detects all 10 perturbations. Evaluating six user simulators on 351 real multi-turn sessions in which 348 distinct users across 23 languages and agents work together to create and refine artifacts such as full-stack web apps, games, design assets, and automated workflows, we find that population-level measures can miss when a simulated user pursues the wrong goal, ignores a constraint, or behaves out of character, highlighting the need to assess fidelity at comprehensive granularities.

AI.tldr: 本文元评估了现有用户模拟器评估指标，发现其无法可靠检测模拟行为失败，并提出新的多粒度保真度评估套件。
AI.motivation: 现有用户模拟器评估框架能否可靠检测模拟用户行为中的有意义失败尚不明确，高基准分数与模拟器质量之间的关系难以解读，因此需要对评估指标本身进行元评估。
AI.method: 通过故意扰动模拟回放诱导已知的失败类型（如改变目标、遗漏约束、过早停止、接受破损工作），测试现有指标能否惩罚这些失败；随后提出结合智能体评估效用、群体级保真度（集体交互模式）和轨迹级保真度（个体用户目标、约束、人设保持）的新评估套件。
AI.result: 三项先前研究的评估方法仅检测出10项扰动中的5-6项，其综合评分甚至倾向接受破损工作的人群；新评估套件检测出全部10项扰动。对6个用户模拟器在351个真实多轮会话（348用户、23语言、创建Web应用、游戏等工件）的评估显示，群体级测量会遗漏追求错误目标、忽视约束或行为失格等情况。
AI.conclusion: 仅群体级保真度不足以捕获所有模拟行为失败，需在全面粒度（包括轨迹级）上评估模拟器对真实用户的保真度，才能真正保证用户模拟器的质量。

title: Who are you? The Personal Imitation Game
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) now perform strongly on Alan Turing's 1950 Imitation Game, so we propose a harder challenge, the Personal Imitation Game, which asks whether a machine can replicate a specific individual in conversation rather than a generic human. Testing with 30 participants, we establish a human baseline and report the identity signals interrogators rely on: stylometric features, personality traits, and biographical facts. To demonstrate the framework, we design an LLM-based system that plays the game for one of the paper's authors, drawing on an autoethnographic dataset spanning ten years of personal digital communication. In a 20-person deception study, interrogators choose our system over the author's own friends in 7 of 10 rounds, and the author over our system in 13 of 20; neither rate is distinguishable from chance at this sample size. We consider design improvements, applications of personal AI agents, and implications for identity and privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了“个人模仿游戏”，挑战大型语言模型模仿特定个体，并展示了基于作者十年个人数字通信数据训练的LLM系统能复制其对话身份。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在传统的图灵模仿游戏中表现优异，因此本文旨在提出一个更难的挑战，即测试机器能否在对话中复制特定个体而非普通人类，并探讨其对身份和隐私的意义。
AI.method: 研究通过30名参与者建立人类基准以识别身份信号（文体特征、性格特征和传记事实），并利用一位作者十年的个人数字通信数据集开发了一个基于LLM的系统，随后进行了20人的欺骗实验。
AI.result: 在欺骗实验中，测试者在10轮中的7轮选择了AI系统而非作者的朋友，在20轮中的13轮选择了作者而非AI系统；在当前样本量下，这两个比例均无法与随机概率区分。
AI.conclusion: 当前的LLM能在一定程度上模仿特定个体，其表现与随机概率及熟人判断相当，这表明个人AI代理具有应用潜力，同时也凸显了身份和隐私方面的影响及未来设计改进方向。

title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
summary: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The AI Scientist. Its methodological novelty does not differ significantly from the Research Ideation Agent, while its feasibility scores are higher on both backbones. With a shared experiment executor, CAR achieves the highest pairwise win rate among the evaluated AI methods on FML-bench-Lite and BioXArena. In a ten-condition ablation study, MN point estimates favor CAR over one-step proposal on both backbones, but no MN contrast survives correction for multiple comparisons. The results do not establish a consistent quality benefit from explicit operators beyond free-form iteration. CAR makes the sequence of operations and declared literature sources inspectable, separating judged idea quality from procedural traceability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CAR框架，通过结合文献知识图谱、迭代开发与显式概念算子来提升大语言模型的自动化科研创意生成能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能生成看似合理的科研创意，但自动化创意生成的有效机制尚不明确，且新提案如何从已有科学工作中衍生这一问题缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: CAR框架从检索文献构建语义知识图谱，为创意生成智能体配备图谱检索工具及四种概念算子（跨界联想、类比、探索、细化），每次算子调用依据结构性接受条件进行检查并记录，产生中间变换轨迹和声明文献来源的可追溯记录。
AI.result: CAR在40个LiveIdeaBench研究主题上的方法新颖性显著高于单次提示和AI Scientist，在可行性评分上优于Research Ideation Agent；在FML-bench-Lite和BioXArena上获得最高胜率；但消融实验未能在多重比较校正后确认显式算子相对于自由迭代的持续性质量优势。
AI.conclusion: CAR的核心贡献在于将操作序列和文献来源变得可审查，实现了创意质量与过程可追溯性的分离；未来可进一步探索显式概念算子在实际质量提升中的独立作用。

title: Local AI Agents in Power Electronics Simulation: Deployment, Measurements and Costs
summary: Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) is emerging in power electronics, where it drives the simulation loop that engineers used to close largely by hand. In this loop, a converter design, or a study of the network it connects to, is built, run, measured and revised until it satisfies its specification. Such an agent can be served from a cloud API or from an inference device on the premises. For organizations whose designs, customer data or export-controlled material cannot leave the site, and whose simulators are licensed there, local deployment is the natural choice. In such a deployment, the agent becomes an electrical load on the organization's own equipment, i.e., every run consumes power and energy on a local device, generates tokens and takes time. However, existing work focuses mainly on what the agent can achieve with cloud-hosted models. What a local deployment costs in power, energy, tokens and time on real simulation tasks, and what its choices trade against one another, has received little quantitative investigation under comparable conditions. To address this gap, a systematic evaluation framework is presented in this paper. It applies locally served models to agentic power electronics tasks, from the converter level to the system level, and measures their power, energy, token and time costs. Based on these measurements, the capability boundary of a local agent on such tasks and the cost per solved task are characterized. The results are expected to provide practical insight for the use of agentic AI in power electronics and the power systems it serves.

AI.tldr: 提出本地部署智能体AI在电力电子仿真任务中的成本评估框架，量化功耗、能量、token与时间开销并刻画能力边界。
AI.motivation: 针对敏感数据或许可证限制下需本地部署的场景，现有研究多聚焦云端模型能力，缺乏对本地部署在实际仿真任务中功耗、能量、token和时间成本的定量对比研究。
AI.method: 构建系统评估框架，应用本地服务模型执行从变换器级到系统级的代理式电力电子任务，测量其功耗、能量、token与时间成本，并据此刻画本地代理的能力边界及每解决任务的成本。
AI.result: 基于实测数据量化了本地部署代理在多层级任务中的资源消耗，明确了功耗、能量、token与时间之间的权衡关系及单位任务成本特征。
AI.conclusion: 为代理式AI在电力电子及电力系统中的本地应用提供实用参考，揭示能力与成本约束，支撑部署决策。

title: Learning to Interact in Multi-Agent Self-Play for Controllable Autonomous Driving Scenario Generation
summary: Large-scale, multi-agent self-play trains robust driving policies effectively in simulation, but controlling these models to generate specific, safety-critical edge cases remains a key challenge. Existing goal-conditioned self-play frameworks rely primarily on static map-location goals and fail to reliably produce complex agent interactions such as aggressive tailgating or adversarial cut-offs. These agent interactions are necessary for rigorous autonomous vehicle (AV) testing. To address this, we present an extended multi-agent self-play framework that introduces agent-relative dynamic goals. By conditioning policies on this extended goal representation, our framework enables targeted, controllable scenario synthesis. We demonstrate that our approach successfully generates interactive driving behaviors that static-goal baselines cannot simulate, providing a flexible tool for long-tail scenario generation in AV testing.

AI.tldr: 提出一种引入智能体相对动态目标的多智能体自博弈框架，以可控地生成自动驾驶测试所需的安全关键复杂交互场景。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于静态地图位置目标的自博弈框架难以可靠生成激进尾随或敌意切断等复杂的智能体交互行为，无法满足自动驾驶严苛测试的需求。
AI.method: 扩展多智能体自博弈框架并引入智能体相对动态目标表示，通过基于该扩展目标进行策略条件化，实现有针对性且可控的场景合成。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法成功生成了静态目标基线模型无法模拟的交互式驾驶行为，有效实现了所需复杂边缘场景的生成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为自动驾驶测试中的长尾场景生成提供了一种灵活工具，突破了现有方法无法模拟复杂车辆交互行为的局限。

AI.motivation: 解决视觉智能体在有限观测预算下阅读密集文档时，传统准确率指标混淆观察位置、适应方式和回答方式，无法独立评估规划能力的问题。
AI.method: 引入预算配对反事实审计，在固定公开证据和区域绑定的情况下，仅扰动剩余预算或任务参数，并为每个已获取历史赋予精确的续值。
AI.result: 该计分方法将预期准确率的损失分解为逐步获取损失和终端决策损失，实现了规划与固定角色启发式策略的分离。
AI.conclusion: 该评估协议为分析和改进视觉智能体在有限预算下的规划与决策行为提供了更精细的量化工具。

title: The Hidden Cost of MoE Diffusion Decoding: Profiling and Fixing the Sampler
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) decode by iteratively denoising a full canvas of tokens, so every forward pass runs a per-token sampling and stopping pipeline over the entire canvas-by-vocabulary logits tensor. We profile single-user decoding of a 26B-parameter diffusion Mixture-of-Experts model on a bandwidth-bound edge accelerator (NVIDIA GB10) and report a result that is easy to miss: after weight quantisation, this logits pipeline, not the expert GEMMs, is the single largest consumer of decode time. Unlike autoregressive decoding, where sampling touches one position's logits per committed token, diffusion decoding processes S times as many logit entries per output token, where S is the number of denoising steps. We show this pipeline is largely redundant or fusable and remove it in two lossless tiers: a bit-exact tier whose output is byte-identical to the reference decoder, and an accuracy-parity tier using a fused single-pass entropy kernel and Gumbel-max sampling. Combined with a W4A16 expert kernel, the full stack reaches 2.4-2.7 times end-to-end speedup over bf16 at unchanged benchmark accuracy on GSM8K, HumanEval, and MATH, on a single 273 GB/s device. We confirm the finding on a second, independently built diffusion MoE (LLaDA2.0-mini: pipeline 28.8% of decode, fused W4A16 3.3 times at accuracy parity) and show it disappears on a dense diffusion model (3.6%). The cost is specific to MoE diffusion, where quantisation makes the backbone cheap. Code and quantised weights are released.

AI.tldr: 本文通过融合和移除冗余的logits处理流水线，结合W4A16专家核，无损加速了边缘设备上量化MoE扩散语言模型的解码过程。
AI.motivation: 在带宽受限的边缘加速器上，量化后的26B参数扩散MoE模型的解码瓶颈不再是对专家GEMM的计算，而是对全画布逐词元采样和停止的logits处理流水线，因为扩散解码处理的logits条目数量是自回归解码的S倍（S为去噪步数）。
AI.method: 提出两层无损优化策略：1) 比特精确层，输出与参考解码器完全一致；2) 精度对齐层，采用融合单次熵核与Gumbel-max采样。此外结合W4A16专家核以进一步降低骨干网络成本。
AI.result: 在单块273 GB/s设备上实现2.4-2.7倍端到端解码加速，且在GSM8K、HumanEval和MATH上精度不变。在另一独立MoE模型上同样实现3.3倍加速（该流水线占解码耗时28.8%），并确认该耗时瓶颈在稠密扩散模型中不存在（仅占3.6%）。
AI.conclusion: 该logits流水线瓶颈是MoE扩散模型在量化后特有的现象。所提融合与移除方法能以无损方式显著提升推理速度，具体代码和量化权重已开源。

title: DRAMA: Dissecting Attention Redundancy for Accelerating Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional attention, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive vision-language modeling. However, each denoising step requires a full forward pass over long multimodal sequences in which visual tokens dominate the sequence length, and a fixed step budget further compounds this quadratic per-step cost. Existing inference acceleration approaches for multimodal dLLMs characterize attention redundancy implicitly, motivating designs from isolated attention visualizations rather than from measurement. We close this gap with DRAMA, a training-free acceleration framework grounded in a systematic dissection of attention redundancy in multimodal dLLMs. By probing attention tensors along spatial and temporal axes, we reveal two persistent redundancy structures: (i) attention mass consistently concentrates on a sparse subset of visual tokens, and (ii) attention distributions rapidly stabilize across denoising steps after an initial formation phase. These findings motivate two complementary mechanisms: Spatial-Redundancy-Aware Visual Token Pruning (SVTP) and Sufficiency-Guided Adaptive Stopping (SGAS). Together, DRAMA achieves an average 18.67 times inference speedup across six vision-language benchmarks without training, architectural modification, or attention caching, while maintaining competitive accuracy. Our results establish a strong, measurement-grounded acceleration baseline for multimodal dLLM inference.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个无训练的多模态扩散语言模型加速框架DRAMA，通过剖析并减少注意力冗余以大幅提升推理速度并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 多模态扩散语言模型在每步去噪时需对视觉主导的长序列进行全前向传递，导致二次方计算成本高且固定步数进一步加剧开销，而现有加速方法缺乏对注意力冗余的显式测量。
AI.method: 探查空间和时间轴上的注意力冗余结构，提出空间冗余感知视觉Token剪枝（SVTP）和充分性引导的自适应停止（SGAS）两种互补机制。
AI.result: 在六个视觉-语言基准测试中平均实现18.67倍的推理加速，无需训练、架构修改或注意力缓存即可保持具竞争力的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 为多模态扩散语言模型推理建立了一个强大的、基于测量的加速基线。

title: Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation: Training-Free Long-Context Extrapolation for Diffusion LLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate by iteratively unmasking tokens with bidirectional attention, but rotary position embeddings (RoPE) still confine them to a fixed pretraining window. Existing training-free extrapolation, notably LongLLaDA, copies NTK-based RoPE scaling from autoregressive (AR) models and applies one static, length-only transform at every position and denoising step. That transplant ignores a signal unique to dLLMs: the evolving mask pattern of the partially decoded sequence. We propose Mask-Pattern Position Augmentation (MPPA). MPPA linearly interpolates indices into the pretrained window, then adds a per-position, per-step offset from cumulative mask density. The offset restores rotary phase resolution that interpolation collapses, and it shrinks as tokens are committed, so late steps see near-clean interpolated geometry. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct at twice its 4096-token window, MPPA reduces perplexity from 19.51 under standard decoding to 3.12 at 8192 tokens, below the in-window figure, with 100% passkey retrieval and unchanged needle-in-a-haystack accuracy. These preliminary $2\times$ results motivate mask-conditioned position engineering as a diffusion-native path to long-context generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了掩码模式位置增强（MPPA）方法，通过利用扩散语言模型解码过程中演变的掩码模式，有效解决了其固定上下文窗口限制并实现了两倍长度的上下文外推。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型受限于旋转位置嵌入的固定预训练窗口，现有免训练外推方法（如LongLLaDA）直接照搬自回归模型的缩放策略，忽略了dLLM在部分解码序列中不断演变的掩码模式这一独特信号。
AI.method: 提出掩码模式位置增强（MPPA），将索引线性插值到预训练窗口中，并基于累积掩码密度添加每个位置和每个解码步骤的偏移量。该偏移量恢复了插值破坏的旋转相位分辨率，并随token确定而缩小，确保后期步骤保持干净的插值几何结构。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B-Instruct的两倍上下文窗口（8192 tokens）下，MPPA将困惑度从标准解码的19.51降至3.12（低于窗口内水平），实现了100%的密钥检索率和不变的大海捞针准确率。
AI.conclusion: 基于掩码条件的位置工程是扩散模型实现长上下文生成的一条原生有效途径，初步的两倍外推结果为该方向提供了有力支持。

title: Beyond the Prompt: Leveraging Pre-Decoding States for Jailbreak Detection in dLLMs
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have recently emerged as a strong alternative to autoregressive models, generating responses by iteratively refining masked tokens in parallel rather than decoding sequentially. While enabling more efficient and flexible inference, dLLMs remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks, including recent attacks that exploit properties unique to dLLMs such as bidirectional conditioning and parallel masked-token refinement. In this work, we show that these same properties also expose a safety-relevant detection surface absent from standard autoregressive decoding: even when a jailbreak is difficult to identify from prompt representations alone, it can still be detected from hidden states over masked response positions before any tokens are generated. By training linear classifiers on prompt and pre-decoding response representations, we empirically show that neither view strictly dominates, with each detecting attacks that the other misses. We introduce $\texttt{ReFuse}$ (Representation Fusion), an inference-time detector that fuses the sigmoid harmfulness scores of the two classifiers. Without modifying model weights or the decoding procedure, $\texttt{ReFuse}$ reduces average ASR across multiple jailbreaks from 63.29% for the undefended model and 11.27% for a prompt-only classifier to 3.31%, while keeping average benign refusal on standard utility benchmarks below 1% on LLaDA-8B. Together, these results establish $\texttt{ReFuse}$ as a lightweight jailbreak detector for dLLMs that improves safety beyond prompt-only detection.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）的越狱攻击防御问题，提出了一种推理时检测器ReFuse，通过融合提示和预解码响应表征的线性分类器分数，显著降低攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型虽然具有高效灵活的推理特性，但仍然容易受到越狱攻击，包括利用其双向条件和并行掩码token细化等独特属性的攻击。现有仅基于提示表征的检测方法存在局限，无法完全识别所有攻击，因此需要一种更全面的检测方法。
AI.method: 本文提出ReFuse（Representation Fusion）推理时检测器，核心方法是将提示表征分类器和预解码响应表征分类器的sigmoid危害性分数进行融合。该方法不修改模型权重或解码流程，利用dLLMs预解码阶段掩码响应位置隐藏状态这一独特的安全相关检测面，弥补了仅基于提示检测的不足。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-8B模型上，ReFuse将多种越狱攻击的平均攻击成功率（ASR）从无防御模型的63.29%和仅提示分类器的11.27%降至3.31%，同时在标准效用基准上的平均良性拒绝率保持在1%以下。实验表明，提示视角和预解码响应视角各自能检测到对方遗漏的攻击，两者互为补充而非完全包含。
AI.conclusion: ReFuse作为一种轻量级推理时越狱检测器，无需修改模型权重或解码流程，即可在dLLMs上实现超越仅提示检测的安全提升。研究结果揭示了dLLMs预解码响应表征中独有的安全检测价值，为dLLMs的安全防御提供了新方向。

title: PBPO: Prefix-Block Policy Optimization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) commonly decode responses by proceeding autoregressively across blocks while iteratively denoising multiple tokens within each block. This structure makes block-level policy optimization a natural adaptation of autoregressive policy optimization. However, the exact likelihood of a completed block is intractable because it marginalizes over the intermediate states and reveal orders of the denoising process. To realize the block-level formulation, we construct a prefix-block state and use a single model evaluation to define a factorized one-step surrogate for the block likelihood. The resulting block surrogate ratio is a product of its token surrogate ratios, allowing variation at individual positions to propagate across the entire block before clipping. We therefore introduce Prefix-Block Policy Optimization (PBPO), which preserves block-level conditioning but applies surrogate importance weighting and clipping separately to each token. PBPO further diversifies repeated updates by resampling corrupted views of the prompt and revealed prefix, a design motivated by masked-dLLM pre-training. Under our analysis assumptions, block-product weighting amplifies the variance of gradient contributions relative to token-local weighting. Across two LLaDA-family initializations, six benchmarks, and three generation lengths, PBPO achieves competitive performance against existing dLLM RL methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了前缀块策略优化方法（PBPO），通过构建因子化的块似然代理并在令牌级别分别进行重要性加权和裁剪，解决了扩散语言模型中块级策略优化的似然不可计算问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）按照块进行自回归解码并在块内迭代去噪多个令牌，使块级策略优化成为自然选择。然而，完整块的精确似然需要对去噪过程的中间状态和揭示顺序进行边际化，导致其不可计算，阻碍了块级策略优化的直接应用。
AI.method: 构建前缀块状态，用单次模型评估定义块似然的因子化单步代理；块代理比率等于令牌代理比率的乘积，使单位置变化能在裁剪前传播至整块。基于此提出PBPO：保留块级条件但对每个令牌分别应用代理重要性加权和裁剪；并通过重采样提示和已揭示前缀的损坏视图来多样化重复更新。
AI.result: 在两个LLaDA家族初始化、六个基准测试和三种生成长度上，PBPO相比现有dLLM强化学习方法取得了有竞争力的表现。分析表明，块乘积加权相比于令牌局部加权会放大梯度贡献的方差。
AI.conclusion: PBPO成功实现了dLLM中块级条件保持与令牌级别优化的平衡，为扩散语言模型的强化学习提供了一种有效的策略优化范式；块乘积加权的方差放大特性为未来改进方向提供了理论分析依据。

title: VIGOR: Visual Gain Ordering for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Multimodal discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate responses through iterative mask prediction and offer a promising alternative to autoregressive large vision-language models. However, they still suffer from hallucination, producing outputs that are plausible under language priors but insufficiently grounded in the image. We argue that hallucination in multimodal dLLMs is not only a token prediction problem, but also a premature commitment problem: during iterative denoising, some masked positions are unmasked too early because their confidence is driven more by language priors than by visual evidence, and these early commitments can bias later generation. To address this issue, we propose Visual Gain Ordering (VIGOR), a training-free and plug-and-play inference strategy that reorders masked positions according to counterfactual visual evidence. At each denoising step, VIGOR compares the confidence of each candidate token under the original image-conditioned pass and an additional visual-ablation pass, and prioritizes positions whose predictions are more strongly supported by the image. Experiments on LLaDA-V and Lumina-DiMOO show that VIGOR consistently reduces hallucination and improves multimodal reasoning performance across benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/THU-BPM/Vigor.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VIGOR方法，一种无需训练的即插即用推理策略，通过反事实视觉证据重新排序掩码位置来缓解多模态离散扩散语言模型的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态离散扩散语言模型虽然在生成方式上具有优势，但仍存在幻觉问题，即输出符合语言先验但与图像不够匹配。本文认为这不仅是一个token预测问题，更是一个过早承诺问题：在迭代去噪过程中，某些掩码位置因语言先vestal驱动而非视觉证据驱动而过早解码，从而影响后续生成。
AI.method: 提出Visual Gain Ordering（VIGOR）方法，在每一步去噪时，对每个候选token分别在原始图像条件和一个视觉消融条件下计算置信度，通过比较两者差异来评估视觉证据的支持强度，并优先解码那些更依赖视觉信息的位置。
AI.result: 在LLaDA-V和Lumina-DiMOO模型上的实验表明，VIGOR在多个基准测试中持续降低了幻觉现象，并提升了多模态推理性能。
AI.conclusion: VIGOR作为一种无需训练、即插即用的推理策略，有效缓解了多模态dLLM的幻觉问题，证明了通过反事实视觉证据引导解码顺序的可行性和有效性，为多模态扩散模型的改进提供了新方向。

title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Step-dLLM，一种针对扩散语言模型的两阶段块稀疏注意力加速方法，通过周期性刷新稀疏掩码和头自适应预算分配，在无需重训的情况下实现 2.78 倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）因双向注意力无法使用 KV 缓存，每一步去噪都要重算完整注意力图，产生二次方开销。现有稀疏注意力方法在初始全注意力后固定掩码并均匀分配预算，忽略了注意力模式在步骤间的局部一致性与突变性，以及不同头注意力集中度的差异，导致效率与精度均不理想。
AI.method: Step-dLLM 沿去噪轨迹在锚点步骤周期性刷新块稀疏掩码，并在每个局部一致区间内复用；同时采用头自适应全局稀疏预算，对注意力集中的头更激进地压缩。配套实现了基于 Triton 的融合 IO 感知块稀疏注意力内核，可直接应用于预训练模型而无需重训。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA-1.5 上以 8K 上下文、256 去噪步、90% 稀疏度，相比密集 FlashAttention 实现端到端 2.78 倍加速；在精度-延迟权衡上优于已有稀疏注意力方法，适用于 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream-7B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 利用 dLLM 注意力在步骤间的局部一致性与头间集中度差异进行自适应稀疏化，可在不重训的前提下显著加速预训练扩散语言模型，为 dLLM 的高效部署提供了新范式。

title: KV Cache Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: KV cache quantization is well studied for autoregressive language models, where cached prefix states are exact under causal attention and quantization is mainly a cache reconstruction problem. Diffusion language models (dLLMs) break this assumption. Fast dLLM inference reuses KV states across denoising steps, but bidirectional token representations can change as masked tokens are revealed, so the reused cache may already differ from full recomputation before quantization is applied. We study KV cache quantization under this cache-reuse error. We adapt KIVI and KVQuant to Fast-dLLM-style prefix and dual cache reuse, and introduce TRACE and dLLM-KVQ. TRACE reconstructs feasible dLLM reveal trajectories from prompt-answer pairs, providing calibration states that match iterative masked decoding. dLLM-KVQ uses these trajectories to choose per-layer K-cache entries that remain in high precision according to output- and attention-level behavior metrics, while applying standard low-bit value quantization. Across LLaDA and Dream evaluations on GSM8K, HumanEval, MATH, and MBPP, dLLM-KVQ achieves the highest average score among quantized methods across the reported 4-bit and 2-bit prefix/dual cache settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散语言模型中存在缓存重用误差时的KV缓存量化问题，提出了TRACE和dLLM-KVQ方法以降低量化精度损失。
AI.motivation: 传统自回归语言模型的KV缓存量化假设缓存前缀状态是精确的，但扩散语言模型在去噪步骤间重用KV状态时，由于双向token表示会随掩码揭示而变化，重用缓存已与全量重计算存在偏差，这使得已有量化方法在未考虑该误差时性能下降。
AI.method: 提出TRACE方法，通过提示-答案对重建可行的dLLM揭示轨迹，提供匹配迭代掩码解码的校准状态；提出dLLM-KVQ，利用这些轨迹根据输出和注意力层级行为指标，选择每层K缓存中需保持高精度的条目，同时对值应用标准低位量化。
AI.result: 在LLaDA和Dream模型上针对GSM8K、HumanEval、MATH和MBPP的实验表明，在报告的4-bit和2-bit前缀/双缓存设置下，dLLM-KVQ在量化方法中取得了最高的平均得分。
AI.conclusion: dLLM-KVQ有效缓解了扩散语言模型KV缓存量化中由缓存重用误差引起的精度损失，为扩散语言模型高效推理提供了可行的低比特量化方案。

title: DWISE: Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine
summary: Unlike autoregressive large language models (AR-LLMs), diffusion LLMs (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising many tokens in parallel, offering a promising path to efficient inference. Existing serving frameworks, however, schedule dLLM requests with policies designed for AR models, namely first-come-first-served (FCFS) admission and prefill priority. We find that both policies are ill-suited to dLLMs, wasting much of their speed. FCFS ignores that a dLLM request's decoding cost is highly heterogeneous and unknown at arrival, causing severe head-of-line blocking. Prefill priority, widely used in AR-LLM serving to keep time-to-first-token low, sharply cuts dLLM efficiency, as rounds that run only prompts leave most of the batch idle. We present DWISE, a Denoising Workload-Informed Scheduling Engine for efficient dLLM serving. DWISE schedules requests by their remaining work, measured in a block-level unit shared by prefill and denoising, so both phases share a round. To predict the unknown denoising workload, DWISE combines a lightweight prompt-based predictor at admission with a single refinement from the first denoising round's hidden states, which capture model-specific information absent from the prompt and require no additional model execution. Implemented in SGLang and evaluated on five models from three dLLM families under bursty workloads, DWISE reduces mean end-to-end latency over SGLang by 5.4$\times$ on average and up to 14.9$\times$ while preserving task accuracy. The code will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DWISE，一种专为扩散语言模型(dLLM)设计的调度引擎，通过基于去噪工作量的调度策略大幅提升服务效率。
AI.motivation: 现有服务框架沿用自回归模型的FCFS和prefill优先策略调度dLLM请求，但FCFS忽略dLLM解码成本的高度异质性导致队头阻塞，prefill优先则使仅处理prompt的轮次浪费大部分批次容量，两者均严重损害dLLM的推理速度优势。
AI.method: DWISE以块级剩余工作量为单位调度请求，使prefill与去噪阶段共享同一轮次；通过轻量级基于prompt的预测器在准入时预估去噪工作量，再利用首轮去噪的隐藏状态进行一次精化，无需额外模型执行即可捕获模型特有信息。
AI.result: 在SGLang上实现，对三类dLLM家族的五个模型在突发负载下进行评测，DWISE平均降低端到端延迟5.4倍，最高达14.9倍，同时保持任务精度。
AI.conclusion: 针对dLLM特性设计的调度策略能显著释放其并行解码的效率潜力，验证了工作量感知调度对dLLM服务的关键价值；代码将公开发布。

title: Cord: Confidence-Anchored Order Residual Decoding for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: The decoding order of masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) can substantially affect generation quality, yet common decoders typically apply the same reveal rule throughout generation. Confidence provides a strong default, but it measures how decisively a position can be predicted now, not how useful revealing that position will be for subsequent decoding. We propose Cord, a lightweight prompt-conditioned policy that retains confidence decoding as a stable reference and learns when and how to depart from it through geometric residuals over generation direction, proximity to revealed context, and two-sided infilling. The residuals adapt to both the prompt and the evolving partial response. Rather than sampling a new policy action at every decoding step, Cord samples a single low-dimensional coefficient matrix per rollout, which induces an entire state-dependent reveal trajectory. This yields a contextual-bandit formulation trained directly from sequence-level rewards, without step-level credit assignment or backbone updates. Across three dLLMs and five reasoning, code, and constraint-satisfaction benchmarks, Cord improves average task success from 32.0% under confidence decoding to 48.2%, and further improves over the best per-domain fixed residual. Behavioral audits show that the learned residuals induce substantial, task-dependent changes in reveal locality and two-sided infilling. Cord adds only $0.53$M trainable parameters, requires no additional backbone forward passes, and incurs only 5.39% inference latency overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出Cord，一种轻量级提示条件解码策略，通过几何残差学习何时偏离置信度解码规则，显著提升掩码扩散语言模型的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型的解码顺序影响生成质量，但现有解码器通常全程使用相同的揭示规则（如置信度），而置信度仅衡量当前位置可预测的确定性，无法反映揭示该位置对后续解码的有用性。
AI.method: Cord保留置信度解码作为稳定参考，通过生成方向、已揭示上下文距离和双向填充的几何残差学习何时偏离;每次rollout仅采样一个低维系数矩阵以诱导完整的状态相关揭示轨迹;采用上下文老虎机公式从序列级奖励训练，无需逐步骤信用分配或骨干网络更新。
AI.result: 在3个dLLM和5个推理、代码、约束满足基准上，平均任务成功率从置信度解码的32.0%提升至48.2%，并超过最佳领域固定残差;仅增加0.53M可训练参数，推理延迟开销仅5.39%，无需额外骨干网络前向传播。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的残差诱导了显著的、任务依赖的揭示局部性和双向填充变化，证明了一种高效、低开销的自适应解码顺序优化方法的有效性。

title: DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by having a lightweight drafter propose future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash predict an entire block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds draft trees directly from their per-position distributions. Each distribution implicitly assumes that the drafter's own greedy continuation is accepted, whereas a draft tree improves over a chain only on branches that leave this greedy path. Once a path forks, the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its top candidates often miss the true token. Re-running the drafter from the fork token largely restores its accuracy, showing that the errors stem from conditioning on an outdated prefix rather than from limited model capacity. In this paper, we introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. It adjusts the drafter's scores with pointwise mutual information from target-generated n-grams, weighted more heavily after a fork, and a layer-wise GPU search recovers the exact optimal tree under these scores. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, DForkTree outperforms all baselines on every benchmark, by up to 41.5% over DFlash and 15.1% over DDTree, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: DForkTree是一种无需训练的推测解码方法，通过在分支处分叉处重新锚定draft树，利用互信息校正drafter分数并执行层级GPU搜索以获得最优树。
AI.motivation: 块扩散drafter（如DFlash/DDTree）在构建draft树时隐式假设自身贪心续接被接受，一旦路径分裂，drafter的top-1准确率从89%骤降至18%，因为它仍基于过时前缀进行条件化；论文旨在解决分叉后条件不匹配导致的准确率崩塌问题。
AI.method: DForkTree在无需训练的前提下，将每个分支重新锚定到其自身token上，利用目标模型生成的n-gram的逐点互信息（PMI）调整drafter分数，并在分叉后加大对PMI的权重，再通过层级GPU搜索在上述分数下恢复精确最优draft树。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B和9B上，DForkTree在所有基准上均优于所有基线，相较DFlash最高提升41.5%，相较DDTree最高提升15.1%，平均加速比自回归解码最高达4.75倍。
AI.conclusion: 分叉后准确率下降源于前缀过时而非模型容量不足，通过重新锚定分支并基于互信息校正分数可有效恢复drafter准确性，从而显著提升推测解码效率。

title: Multi-Future Drafting: Mixture Block Drafters for Tree-Verified Speculative Decoding
summary: Block drafters such as DFlash draft a block of future tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees such as DDTree verify the prefixes ranked highest by the product of the drafter's per-position distributions. Under tree verification, the expected number of accepted tokens is the probability mass the tree covers. We show that a product misallocates it: when the continuation can follow several futures, it splices them into chimeras, prefixes stitched together from different futures that the target never produces, and gives them as much budget as the futures themselves. Barring ties, no product-ranked tree can hold two futures that disagree in $m$ positions without $2^{m-1}-1$ chimeras, however well the drafter is trained, and in practice chimeras make up 27-33% of a 64-node tree. We propose Multi-Future Drafting (MFD), which restores the coupling with a latent variable instead of the chain rule: $K$ learned mode embeddings at the drafter's input draft $K$ coherent blocks in the same pass, and a mixture DDTree lets the verifier pick the future the target takes, losslessly and with $K+1$ extra vectors. On four Qwen targets from 4B to 27B parameters, at batch size 1, MFD reaches up to 7.8$\times$ speedup, 5-8% faster than the best single-mode tree trained identically and, on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, 9-16% faster than the released DARTree trained on the same prompts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多未来草稿方法(MFD)，通过潜在变量替代链式法则恢复草稿块内的连贯性，消除传统乘积排序树中的嵌合体(chimeras)，在Qwen模型上实现最高7.8倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 现有block drafter（如DFlash）和draft tree验证方法使用各位置分布的乘积来排序前缀，当延续存在多个可能的未来时，会将不同未来拼接成target模型永远不会生成的嵌合体前缀，这些嵌合体所占用的验证预算与真实未来一样多，造成预算浪费。实际中64节点树中27-33%为嵌合体。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Future Drafting (MFD)：在草稿器输入端使用K个学习到的mode embedding，在同一次前向传播中生成K个连贯的block；使用mixture DDTree让验证器选择target模型实际采纳的未来，仅需K+1个额外向量，且无损验证。
AI.result: 在4个Qwen目标模型（4B至27B参数）上，batch size 1条件下，MFD实现最高7.8倍加速；比相同训练的最佳单模态树快5-8%；在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B上比相同prompt训练的DARTree快9-16%。
AI.conclusion: 基于乘积的树排序本质上无法避免嵌合体问题，MFD通过潜在变量解耦多未来路径，在无损验证的前提下显著提升推测解码效率，为大模型推理加速提供了新范式。

title: Where Draft Trees Lose Target Mass: Exit-Guided Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding verifies multiple draft continuations in one target-model pass, but finite trees built from draft scores face a fundamental draft-target mismatch. We ask whether better exact verification can increase acceptance on a fixed tree and how target feedback can improve the tree itself. Through a target-flow view, we identify a canonical exit law and prove that one plus target coverage sharply bounds the expected output-block length, including the bonus token, of any exact path verifier. All optimal verifiers share the same exit and bonus-token law, already attained by representative predraw-and-follow and sequential residual verifiers. This yields Tree Exit Verification (TEV), an exact, level-parallel procedure using one exit-node decision and one bonus-token decision. The exit law also identifies missing target probability, providing node-level feedback for Exit-Guided Draft-Tree Training (ExitTrain) on inference-time draft trees. Experiments across dialogue, code, and mathematical reasoning validate fixed-tree equivalence: ExitTrain increases average output-block length by 13%, while TEV reduces verifier-stage latency by 15%, yielding a 14% end-to-end speedup over DDTree. Our results distinguish two opportunities: better draft trees for higher acceptance and more direct verification for lower latency. Code: https://github.com/hsj576/TEV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出树退出验证(TEV)和退出引导草稿树训练(ExitTrain)，分别降低验证延迟并提高接受率，实现端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 树式推测解码中由草稿分数构建的有限树存在草稿与目标模型之间的根本性失配；本文探究更优的精确验证能否在固定树上提升接受率，以及目标反馈能否改进树本身。
AI.method: 通过目标流视角发现规范退出定律，证明其可精确界定任意精确路径验证器的期望输出块长度；据此提出TEV（一种精确的层并行验证过程，仅需一次退出节点决策和一次附加令牌决策）和ExitTrain（利用缺失目标概率作为节点级反馈训练草稿树）。
AI.result: 在对话、代码和数学推理任务上验证了固定树等价性：ExitTrain使平均输出块长度增加13%，TEV使验证阶段延迟降低15%，端到端相比DDTree提速14%。
AI.conclusion: 研究明确了两个优化方向：构建更好的草稿树以提高接受率，以及采用更直接的验证方法以降低延迟。

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.
comment: 31 pages. Submitted to IEEE Access. v4: adds Qwen3.6-27B results, single-GPU serving re-runs, fused tree-builder kernels and tuned budgets; code and data at https://github.com/slin-zhq/Domino-Tree

AI.tldr: DominoTree结合DDTree的树结构与Domino的路径依赖评分机制，提出一种无需训练的最佳优先树解码方法，在低并发场景下显著加速大语言模型推理。
AI.motivation: 现有推测解码方法存在权衡：DDTree能构建树但每个位置独立评分、忽略分支上下文依赖；Domino能基于路径条件评分但仅生成单链，无法并行验证多种续写。需要一种方法同时兼顾树结构的广度与路径依赖评分的准确度。
AI.method: DominoTree将两者结合：采用Domino的路径依赖因果校正对最佳优先树进行评分，限制为top-M候选节点，无需额外训练。针对Gated-DeltaNet等混合架构，引入树感知循环验证机制确保输出正确性。
AI.result: 温度为零时，Qwen3-4B/8B平均加速5.33x/6.89x（峰值8.77x）；全温度下比Domino快20-36%，比DDTree快11-20%。SGLang单卡部署batch=1时达4.11x/4.83x AR加速，比Domino链快1.09-1.17x；8K长文本达1.71x AR。并发≤2时领先，≥8时链式因更高吞吐反超（尽管DominoTree接受率高28%）。混合架构Qwen3.6-27B上batch=1时与链持平（4.58x vs 4.54x），长上下文达2.11x AR。
AI.conclusion: DominoTree在所有服务设置下接受的token数均多于链式方法，在低并发和长上下文场景优势显著；但在高并发场景因吞吐量限制被链式方法超越。路径依赖校正贡献约10%接受长度提升，路径条件贡献约4.5%。树感知循环验证对混合架构必不可少。

title: GRAFT: Adaptive DLM-Based Draft Tree Construction with Target-Distilled Edge Scoring
summary: Tree-based speculative decoding raises the mean accepted tokens of standard speculative decoding by verifying multiple draft paths, and existing tree builders typically construct these paths through parent-conditioned expansion, where each child token is generated conditioned on its parent path. This construction is incompatible with diffusion language model (DLM) drafters such as DFlash, which produces all future-position distributions in a single forward pass. DDTree bridges this gap by treating high-probability tokens from each future-position distribution as candidate nodes and selecting edges between consecutive positions under a fixed node budget. However, its edge selection relies on token probability alone without modeling parent--child compatibility, so target-compatible tokens can be attached to wrong parents; moreover, its fixed budget ignores that the throughput-optimal tree size varies with the decoding state. We propose GRAFT, a draft-tree construction framework for DLM-based speculative decoding. GRAFT introduces Target-Distilled Edge Scoring (TDES), which distills parent--child preferences from target-model traces to select target-compatible edges, and State-Aware Budget Allocation (SABA), which sets the per-round tree budget by balancing expected draft gain against verification cost. Across multiple models and tasks, GRAFT achieves $2.13\times$--$6.36\times$ end-to-end speedup over autoregressive decoding while adding less than $0.5$\,ms of overhead per round, approximately $1.4\%$ of the target-model verification latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了GRAFT框架，通过目标蒸馏边评分和状态感知预算分配，解决扩散语言模型草稿树构建中的父子节点兼容性差和预算固定的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的树构建方法（如DDTree）与扩散语言模型（DLM）起草器不兼容，且仅依赖token概率进行边选择，忽略了父子节点的兼容性；同时其固定预算策略未考虑吞吐量最优树大小随解码状态变化的特性。
AI.method: 提出GRAFT框架，包含目标蒸馏边评分（TDES）和状态感知预算分配（SABA）。TDES从目标模型轨迹中蒸馏父子偏好以选择目标兼容的边；SABA通过平衡预期草稿增益与验证成本来动态设置每轮树预算。
AI.result: 在多个模型和任务上，GRAFT相比自回归解码实现了2.13倍至6.36倍的端到端加速，且每轮增加的开销不到0.5毫秒（约占目标模型验证延迟的1.4%）。
AI.conclusion: GRAFT有效解决了DLM推测解码中的草稿树构建问题，在不引入显著计算开销的前提下大幅提升了推理速度，具有良好的模型与任务泛化能力。

title: Cost-Aware Diffusion Draft Trees for Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates inference by having a lightweight drafter propose tokens verified in parallel by the target language model. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate an entire draft block in one pass, yielding per-position marginals; DDTree uses these to build a candidate tree that maximizes expected acceptance length under a fixed node budget. We observe, however, that acceptance length is non-decreasing in budget: it always favors larger trees regardless of verification cost, offering no principled basis for budget selection. We introduce \textbf{CaDDTree} (Cost-aware Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that directly optimizes token throughput (expected tokens generated per unit time) by jointly selecting the tree structure and node budget. We model draft and verification latencies explicitly, show that the throughput objective decomposes into a per-round one-dimensional search over the budget, and prove that under a convex verification cost the throughput function is \emph{unimodal}, enabling an efficient greedy stopping rule. CaDDTree requires no offline budget search, adapting the budget each round from the current per-position distributions and verification cost. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B across eight benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, and instruction-following tasks show that \caDDTree{} matches or surpasses DDTree with oracle budget selection on nearly all tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CaDDTree，一种成本感知的扩散草稿树方法，通过联合选择树结构和节点预算直接优化推测解码的令牌吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 现有的块扩散草稿器（如DDTree）在固定节点预算下最大化预期接受长度，但这总是偏好更大的树而忽略了验证成本，缺乏选择预算的原则性依据，无法优化实际的令牌吞吐量。
AI.method: CaDDTree显式建模草稿与验证延迟，通过每轮对预算进行一维搜索联合选择树结构和节点预算以直接优化吞吐量。该方法证明了在凸验证成本下吞吐量函数具有单峰性，从而使用高效的贪心停止规则实现每轮动态自适应预算调整，无需离线搜索。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B模型上的八个基准测试（涵盖推理、编码和指令遵循任务）表明，CaDDTree在几乎所有任务上均匹配或超越了带有预知预算选择的DDTree。
AI.conclusion: CaDDTree为推测解码中的草稿树预算选择提供了一种原则性的成本感知方法，无需离线调优即可有效提升推理效率。

title: TAPS: Target-Aware Prefix Tree Selection for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding
summary: Using a diffusion model for parallel drafting is a promising approach for speculative decoding. By predicting tokens at multiple future positions in a single forward pass, diffusion drafters substantially reduce drafting latency. However, this shifts the bottleneck to verification: verifying a single sequence limits acceptance length, while verifying large draft trees incurs excessive target-model latency. We identify a key mismatch in existing draft-tree methods: existing diffusion-tree methods rank nodes by the marginal probability, ignoring that verification is prefix-conditioned. As a result, they may verify unreachable descendants of rejected prefixes, increasing latency with limited acceptance gains. To address this, we propose TAPS, a target-aware prefix selection method that turns diffusion marginals into path-conditioned acceptance estimates. TAPS then selects a compact prefix-closed subtree under a fixed verification budget, improving the acceptance-cost tradeoff rather than simply expanding the draft tree. Experiments across diverse datasets and model families demonstrate that TAPS achieves up to 7.9x lossless end-to-end speedup over vanilla autoregressive decoding, outperforming state-of-the-art DFlash and DDTree by 1.36x and 1.74x respectively. Our work is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TAPS-EMNLP2026-53DD

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TAPS方法，通过目标感知的前缀选择优化扩散模型推测解码中的验证瓶颈，显著提升无损端到端加速比。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型并行起草虽降低了起草延迟，但验证成为新瓶颈。现有起草树方法基于边际概率排序节点，忽略了验证的前缀条件性，导致验证被拒绝前缀的不可达后代，增加延迟且接受率提升有限。
AI.method: 提出TAPS（目标感知前缀选择），将扩散边际转化为路径条件的接受估计，并在固定验证预算下选择紧凑的前缀闭子树，以改善接受与成本的权衡。
AI.result: 实验表明，TAPS相比原始自回归解码实现了高达7.9倍的无损端到端加速，且分别比现有的DFlash和DDTree方法快1.36倍和1.74倍。
AI.conclusion: TAPS通过解决边际概率与前缀条件验证之间的不匹配问题，有效优化了基于扩散的推测解码的验证效率与接受-成本权衡。

title: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Block Diffusion Draft Trees
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive language models by using a lightweight drafter to propose multiple future tokens, which the target model then verifies in parallel. DFlash shows that a block diffusion drafter can generate an entire draft block in a single forward pass and achieve state-of-the-art speculative decoding performance, outperforming strong autoregressive drafters such as EAGLE-3. Vanilla DFlash, however, still verifies only a single drafted trajectory per round, potentially limiting its acceptance length. We introduce DDTree (Diffusion Draft Tree), a method that constructs a draft tree directly from the per-position distributions of a block diffusion drafter. Under a fixed node budget, DDTree uses a simple best-first heap algorithm to select the continuations that are most likely to match the target model according to a surrogate defined by the draft model's output. The resulting tree is verified efficiently in a single target model forward pass using an ancestor-only attention mask. Because DDTree builds on DFlash, a leading draft model for speculative decoding, these gains place DDTree among the leading approaches to speculative decoding.

AI.tldr: DDTree通过从块扩散草稿模型构建草稿树进行多路并行验证，提升了推测解码的接受长度和整体性能。
AI.motivation: 传统的DFlash方法在每轮仅验证单条草稿轨迹，限制了可接受的草稿长度，从而制约了加速效果。
AI.method: 利用块扩散草稿模型的逐位置分布构建草稿树，采用最佳优先堆算法在固定节点预算下筛选最可能匹配的候选序列，并通过仅祖先注意力掩码在目标模型单次前向传播中高效验证。
AI.result: 在DFlash基础上实现了性能增益，达到推测解码领域的最先进水平。
AI.conclusion: DDTree证明了树状草案结构结合块扩散模型能有效提升推测解码性能，确立了其在该领域的领先地位。

title: Ultimate3D: Teaching Multimodal LLMs 3D Camera-Object Relations by Large-Scale Visual Instruction Data
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle with accurately capturing camera-object relations, especially for object orientation, camera viewpoint, and camera shots. This stems from the fact that existing MLLMs are trained on images with limited diverse camera-object relations and corresponding textual descriptions. To address this, we propose a synthetic generation pipeline to create large-scale 3D visual instruction datasets. Our framework takes 3D assets as input and uses rendering and diffusion-based image generation models to create photorealistic images preserving precise camera-object relations. Additionally, large language models (LLMs) are used to generate text prompts for guiding visual instruction tuning and controlling image generation. We create Ultimate3D, a large-scale 3D-grounded 2D visual instruction dataset. Ultimate3D consists of 240K VQAs with precise camera-object annotations, and corresponding benchmark. MLLMs fine-tuned on our proposed dataset outperform commercial models by a large margin, achieving an average accuracy improvement of 29.7% on camera-object relation recognition tasks. Our code, dataset, and benchmark will contribute to broad MLLM applications.
comment: Accepted to Machine Vision and Applications 2027

AI.tldr: 提出一种合成数据生成流水线构建大规模3D视觉指令数据集Ultimate3D，以提升多模态大语言模型对相机-物体关系的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在准确捕捉相机与物体关系（如物体方向、相机视角和镜头）方面存在困难，主要原因是训练数据中缺乏多样化的相机-物体关系及对应的文本描述。
AI.method: 提出一种合成生成流水线，以3D资产为输入，结合渲染和基于扩散模型的图像生成技术创建保持精确相机-物体关系的真实图像，并利用大语言模型生成文本提示以指导视觉指令微调。
AI.result: 构建了包含24万个带有精确相机-物体标注的VQA数据集Ultimate3D及相关基准；在该数据集上微调的模型在相机-物体关系识别任务上的平均准确率较商业模型提升了29.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法显著提升了多模态大语言模型在相机-物体关系识别方面的性能，且相关代码、数据集和基准将开源以促进更广泛的模型应用。

title: A$^3$Bench: Compositional Reasoning over Aggressive Interactions in Videos
summary: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about participant roles in aggressive interactions remains largely unexplored. Existing violence and crime datasets primarily evaluate whether aggression occurs, without testing whether models can identify who performed the action, who received it, and how participants are related within the scene. To address this gap, we introduce A$^3$Bench, a benchmark to study aggressive action and association in videos. The benchmark evaluates whether models can jointly recognize aggressive actions, distinguish aggressors from victims and bystanders, and correctly bind actions to participants under challenging distractor settings. We benchmark 17 multimodal models and find that they struggle substantially on fine-grained aggressive-scene understanding. Performance degrades consistently as reasoning complexity increases, with models frequently confusing aggressors with victims or bystanders, revealing a systematic failure in role-action association rather than coarse aggression recognition alone. We further observe that increasing model scale or generic reasoning models experience limited improvement. Finally, we explore a simple role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions, leading to improvements in compositional reasoning. Our findings highlight that reliable aggressive-scene understanding remains a major challenge for current MLLMs and motivate future research on role-aware video reasoning beyond coarse violence detection. Code and dataset: https://github.com/austincbaker/A3Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了A3Bench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在视频中识别攻击性动作及角色关联（施暴者、受害者、旁观者）的能力
AI.motivation: 现有暴力与犯罪数据集主要评估是否发生攻击行为，未测试模型能否识别动作执行者、承受者及参与者间关系；当前MLLM在攻击性交互中的角色推理能力尚未被充分探索
AI.method: 构建A3Bench基准，联合评估攻击性动作识别、施暴者与受害者/旁观者区分及在干扰条件下的动作-参与者绑定；进一步提出角色图提示策略，鼓励对参与者交互进行结构化推理
AI.result: 17个多模态模型在细粒度攻击场景理解上表现不佳，随推理复杂度增加性能持续下降；模型常混淆施暴者与受害者或旁观者，表明角色-动作关联存在系统性失败；增大模型规模或通用推理能力提升有限；角色图提示策略可改善组合推理表现
AI.conclusion: 可靠的攻击场景理解对当前MLLM仍是重大挑战，需在未来研究角色感知的视频推理，超越粗粒度暴力检测

title: UEmo-D1: An Efficient and Calibrated Decision Model for Unified Multimodal Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal Emotion Recognition (MER) seeks to identify emotions conveyed through or elicited by media comprising diverse modality compositions. Research in this field has largely evolved along two paradigms: task-specific models and approaches based on Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Despite their distinct strengths, neither fully reconciles three capabilities essential to human-like emotion understanding: cross-task generalization, efficient decision-making, and receptiveness to multiple plausible interpretations. Inspired by recent advances in decision models, we explore a unified framework that maps multimodal inputs, guided by natural language instructions, directly to distributions over candidate options, addressing these requirements through direct probabilistic decisions. We instantiate this framework in UEmo-D1, the first decision model for MER to our knowledge. To support joint training and systematic evaluation, we also curate UEmo-Data, comprising 977,270 training samples and 41 evaluation subsets across six MER tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate UEmo-D1's combination of strong recognition performance, low inference latency, and well-calibrated confidence estimates. Complementary analyses further reveal how training strategies and data composition influence these capabilities, providing practical insights into unified MER modeling. Together, our findings establish decision models as a feasible direction toward human-level emotion recognition. Project page: https://github.com/wdqqdw/UEmo-D1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个多模态情感识别决策模型UEmo-D1，通过将多模态输入直接映射到候选选项的分布，实现了具备跨任务泛化、高效决策且支持多解释的情感理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态情感识别范式（任务专用模型和多模态大语言模型）无法同时兼顾跨任务泛化、高效决策和对多种合理情感解释的接受能力。
AI.method: 提出一个统一框架，在自然语言指令引导下将多模态输入直接映射到候选选项的概率分布上进行直接概率决策，并构建了UEmo-D1模型以及包含近百万训练样本和评估子集的UEmo-Data数据集。
AI.result: UEmo-D1在保持强识别性能的同时，实现了低推理延迟和校准良好的置信度估计；补充分析揭示了训练策略和数据组成对这些能力的影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明决策模型是实现人类水平情感识别的可行方向，为统一的多模态情感识别建模提供了实用见解。

title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
summary: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. We present WM^MLLM, the first interactive world model built on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), for persistent, editable world generation from a single image. WM^MLLM keeps the world state outside every generator, as a panorama with a revision history, and lets the MLLMs write it: they turn each request into operations on this state, select where a local edit is written, and check every candidate before it becomes the next state. Image generators only propose views, and video only presents them. Users can walk to new places and return, edit objects through text or a box, place subjects, and change lighting, weather or season. By construction, a revisit at the same revision reproduces the earlier view exactly, a local edit leaves every panorama pixel outside its region unchanged, and each request starts from the result of the previous one. Against six world model baselines on MBench-A, WM^MLLM has the highest mean on all four environment-recovery metrics (Epipolar 91.5 versus 0.1 to 74.0) and completes the most camera round trips (85.3% versus at most 50.9%). It has the best value in all 15 CompBench columns against 15 baselines. On 112 local edits judged blind, selecting the region to write after generation raises completion from 34.8% to 83.0%. On 258 WBench and MBench-A items, all 46 revisits recover their earlier views, and all 97 local edits that pass the check leave panorama pixels outside their region unchanged.
comment: 25 pages, 14 figures, 8 tables; project page: https://ztmotalee.github.io/wmmllm/

AI.tldr: 提出了基于多模态大语言模型的交互式世界模型WM^MLLM，通过将世界状态外部存储为全景图和修订历史，解决了视频世界模型中早期编辑漂移或消失的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频世界模型将世界状态保留在生成器的上下文中，导致重访同一位置时合成的视图会发生漂移或早期编辑会消失，无法实现持久且可编辑的世界生成。
AI.method: WM^MLLM将世界状态存储于生成器之外作为带有修订历史的全景图。多模态大语言模型(MLLM)将用户请求转化为对该状态的操作，选择局部编辑的写入位置，并在形成下一状态前检查每个候选视图。图像生成器仅提出视图，视频负责展示。
AI.result: 在MBench-A基准上，WM^MLLM在四项环境恢复指标上均得分最高（Epipolar为91.5对比0.1-74.0），相机往返完成率最高（85.3%对比最高50.9%）。在CompBench的15个指标上均优于15个基线方法。在局部编辑任务中，生成后选择写入区域使完成率从34.8%提升至83.0%。所有46次重访均完全恢复先前视图，97个通过检查的局部编辑未改变区域外的像素。
AI.conclusion: 通过将世界状态外部化并利用MLLM进行管理，WM^MLLM成功实现了持久、可编辑且时空一致的世界生成，有效解决了传统视频世界模型中的内容漂移问题，为交互式世界建模提供了新范式。

title: NullTok: empirical-null token selection for training-free long video understanding
summary: Long video understanding remains a daunting challenge for existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs), mainly due to the large number of visual tokens accumulated in long videos. Currently, frame selection and token selection are two main paradigms for addressing this issue, both aiming to select relevant visual information to form a compact input for MLLMs. A natural approach combines these two paradigms by selecting frames before pruning tokens, but noisy frame-level relevance estimates can cause irreversible evidence loss. In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of assessing the spatiotemporal distribution of query-specific evidence and propose a novel and training-free approach termed NULLTOK. For every patch across all frames, we construct an empirical-null distribution from 64 group-matched irrelevant control queries, capturing the scores expected in the absence of target-specific evidence. Target affinities are calibrated against these same-position references into right-tail Monte Carlo p-values, which are discrete super-uniform under a conditional exchangeability assumption. Calibrated screening and a high-recall semantic guard produce candidate tokens for deterministic visual deduplication and joint spatiotemporal budget allocation. To validate NullTok, we apply it to two representative MLLMs and conduct extensive experiments on a set of video benchmarks. The experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness under a bounded visual token budget. For example, it achieves 65.81% and 68.85% on Video-MME using frozen LLaVA-Video-7B and Qwen3-VL-8B backbones, respectively, at a cap of 64 full-frame equivalents (FFE), without subtitles or audio. These results outperform all evaluated baselines on Video-MME under the same budget for both backbones. Code is available at https://github.com/potato-kitty/NullTok.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需训练的NULLTOK方法，利用经验零分布校准查询特定证据，以实现长视频中时空视觉token的联合剪枝。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解中视觉token数量庞大导致现有多模态大语言模型面临挑战，现有帧选择与token选择结合的方法会因帧级相关性估计噪声导致不可逆的证据丢失。
AI.method: 提出NULLTOK方法，利用64个无关对照查询构建经验零分布，将目标亲和度校准为右尾蒙特卡洛p值；结合校准筛选和高召回语义守卫生成候选token，进行确定性视觉去重和联合时空预算分配。
AI.result: 在64帧等价预算下，使用LLaVA-Video-7B和Qwen3-VL-8B在Video-MME上分别达到65.81%和68.85%，在相同预算下超越所有评估基线。
AI.conclusion: NULLTOK在受限视觉预算下有效筛选并压缩时空视觉信息，显著提升了长视频理解性能并避免了关键证据丢失。

title: On Demand, Not Uniformity: Adaptive Expert Orchestration for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
summary: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) enables Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to adapt to sequential instruction data while retaining previously acquired knowledge. While recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based methods mitigate forgetting by freezing historical experts and introducing new ones, they largely overlook the varying adaptation demands across tasks. Probing incoming tasks reveals pronounced heterogeneity in layer-wise gradient pressure and token-wise prediction difficulty. This observation highlights two unresolved decisions: where additional capacity is needed and how strongly new experts should contribute to individual tokens. To address both questions, we propose the Coverage-Calibrated Expert Injection and Residual Arbitration framework (CIRA-MoE), which derives expert acceptance margins via learnable threshold routing to serve as a unified coverage signal. Specifically, historical acceptance evidence guides the selective injection of new experts into insufficiently covered layers. Meanwhile, relative evidence between historical and current experts modulates token-wise residual contributions, coupled with arbitration-consistent regularization to promote expert specialization. Comprehensive experiments on UCIT and CoIN demonstrate that CIRA-MoE outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in MCIT.

AI.tldr: 提出CIRA-MoE框架，通过覆盖率校准的专家注入与残差仲裁机制，解决多模态持续指令微调中任务适应性需求差异化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于MoE的多模态持续指令微调方法忽略了不同任务间在层级梯度和token级预测难度上的异构性，未能解决在何处增加容量及新专家对单个token的贡献强度问题。
AI.method: 提出CIRA-MoE框架，通过可学习阈值路由获取专家接受裕度作为覆盖率信号；利用历史接受证据在覆盖不足的层选择性地注入新专家；结合历史与当前专家间的相对证据调节token级残差贡献，并引入仲裁一致性正则化以促进专家特化。
AI.result: 在UCIT和CoIN数据集上的综合实验证明，CIRA-MoE在多模态持续指令微调中优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了新专家容量分配及贡献强度的问题，为多模态大模型在持续学习中的适应性与抗遗忘提供了新方案。

title: ReflectScene:MLLM-Guided Closed-Loop Diffusion for 3D Indoor Scene Generation
summary: Text-conditioned 3D indoor scene generation requires layouts satisfying geometric, functional, and semantic constraints. However, existing diffusion methods rely primarily on static textual conditions, limiting their ability to assess evolving scenes and translate semantic discrepancies into executable object-level corrections. MLLM-based post-hoc refinement provides semantic feedback but remains decoupled from denoising, potentially disrupting scene coherence.We propose ReflectScene, an MLLM-guided closed-loop diffusion framework. First, we introduce Hierarchical Prior-Grounded Scene Understanding that aligns structured layouts with multi-view visual evidence, to interpret object-specific context and scene global semantics via a frozen multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Second, we propose MLLM-Guided Semantic Reward Evaluation to distill MLLM's diagnoses and assessments on possible candidate corrections into a lightweight Reward Predictor, enabling correction decision making with reduced computation burden. Finally, Decision-Conditioned Trajectory-Consistent Diffusion is proposed to integrate selected corrections through transient conditioning and persistent clean-estimate projection, correcting object layout in the generated scene while preserving non-target arrangements throughout denoising.Experiments on 3D-FRONT demonstrate improved functional consistency and semantic alignment while maintaining competitive generation quality and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ReflectScene，一个由多模态大语言模型（MLLM）引导的闭环扩散框架，用于解决文本条件下3D室内场景生成中的语义和功能约束问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D场景扩散方法依赖静态文本条件，无法评估不断演变的场景并将语义差异转化为对象级修正；而基于MLLM的事后优化与去噪过程脱节，容易破坏场景连贯性。
AI.method: 提出ReflectScene框架包含三个核心组件：1）分层先验场景理解，利用冻结MLLM对齐结构化布局与多视图视觉证据；2）MLLM引导的语义奖励评估，将MLLM的诊断蒸馏为轻量级奖励预测器以高效决策修正方案；3）决策条件轨迹一致扩散，通过瞬时条件与持久清洁估计投影在去噪过程中修正目标对象布局同时保留非目标布局。
AI.result: 在3D-FRONT数据集上的实验表明，该方法提升了场景的功能一致性和语义对齐度，同时保持了具有竞争力的生成质量与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 将MLLM语义反馈闭环集成至扩散模型中，能够有效解决3D室内场景生成中的语义和功能差异，且不牺牲场景的连贯性、质量与多样性。

title: SpecLook: Speculating Where to Look for Fast and Reliable Agentic MLLMs
summary: Agentic multimodal large language models (MLLMs) that think with images interleave reasoning with zoom-in tool calls. However, this sequential loop is slow, and its answers carry no reliability score. Prior speculation of tokens, reasoning steps, or answers keeps the loop, and answer speculation also accepts confident errors. We find that the loop mostly adds one zoom-in step, with which a small model is ahead of the agent on most splits. Our key insight is to speculate the agent's next observation, which, unlike a drafted answer, can be verified, corrected, and used to test the answer. We propose SpecLook, a training-free speculate-and-verify framework with three levels. A small model drafts a glimpse and re-answers from it, and the question ends if the answer is unchanged and confident. Otherwise, the agent's large model verifies and corrects the glimpse without tools, and their answers are fused. Only questions that still lack evidence reach the agent, in one forward pass that SpecLook-Fast skips, so no question runs the loop. The trace scores every answer's reliability without labels. Extensive experiments on V*, HR-Bench, and POPE show that both are more accurate than every baseline on every split. SpecLook reaches 87.2% and 86.2% mean accuracy with 7.7x and 4.7x speedups over the DeepEyes-7B and Thyme-RL agents, and SpecLook-Fast reaches 9.9x and 6.3x.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练的推测与验证框架SpecLook，通过推测智能体的下一次视觉观测来加速多模态大模型推理，并利用轨迹评估答案可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态大模型智能体在结合图像缩放工具进行推理时，顺序循环过程缓慢且答案缺乏可靠性评分。
AI.method: 提出SpecLook框架，利用小模型推测并修正智能体的下一次视觉观测，结合大模型进行无工具验证与答案融合，仅将未解决的问题交给智能体处理，无需运行完整循环。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上准确率全面超越基线，相比现有智能体实现了87.2%和86.2%的平均准确率，并带来4.7至9.9倍的显著推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 通过推测和验证观测而非猜测答案，可以完全避免缓慢的推理循环，在大幅提升速度的同时保证高准确率和可靠的无标签评分。

title: VIVID: Beyond Static Multi-Image Reasoning with Localized Visual Differences and Textual Entity Dynamics in Video MLLMs
summary: Video question answering under tight frame budgets requires preserving localized motion and event order, yet current video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reduce comprehension to static multi-image reasoning by discarding unselected frames and encoding keyframes independently: (1) Spatially, whole-frame pooling dilutes small moving targets into static backgrounds; (2) Temporally, dropping intermediate frames or averaging tokens erases inter-frame motion, confusing direction, speed, and order. We propose VIVID (Visual Inter-frame Variations and Individual Dynamics), which moves beyond static snapshots like human vision: keyframes capture core states while inter-frame Patch Diffs preserve neighboring changes within $K_f$ keyframes. Autonomous Delta-Driven Keyframe Planning (ADKP) selects anchors from a $3\text{ fps}$ pool and feeds surrounding patch differences into Dual-Road Change Memory (DRCM), forming Dynamic Tokens at zero extra anchor tokens alongside a camera-stabilized Active Motion Region of Interest (ROI) and chronological Entity State Chains. Adding $0.22\%$ trainable parameters to a frozen $27\text{B}$ backbone, VIVID-Small ($50$ examples, $\sim 1.5$ GPU hours) beats all eleven baselines in overall accuracy across $8,083$ questions and trails only VIVID-Large ($3,600$ examples), which leads on MotionBench, Video-MME, and TempCompass.

AI.tldr: VIVID通过帧间Patch差异和关键帧规划在有限帧预算下保留局部运动与时序顺序，提升视频问答性能。
AI.motivation: 当前视频MLLM将视频理解退化为静态多图推理：空间上整帧池化稀释了小运动目标，时间上丢弃中间帧或平均化token抹除了帧间运动信息，导致方向、速度和顺序理解受损。
AI.method: 提出VIVID框架：(1)自治差异驱动关键帧规划(ADKP)从3fps池中选取锚帧；(2)帧间Patch Diff保留相邻帧变化，零额外锚token生成Dynamic Tokens；(3)双路变化记忆(DRCM)结合相机稳定的主动运动ROI和时序实体状态链；仅训练0.22%参数附加于冻结的27B骨干。
AI.result: VIVID-Small仅用50个样本和约1.5 GPU小时即在8,083个问题上总体准确率超越全部11个基线；VIVID-Large(3,600样本)在MotionBench、Video-MME和TempCompass三个基准上均取得领先。
AI.conclusion: 通过模拟人类视觉机制引入帧间变化表征，VIVID在不增加锚帧token的前提下高效捕捉局部运动与时序信息，证明了小参数量微调即可实现强竞争力的视频理解能力。

title: Stress Testing a Multimodal Large Language Model Grading Assistant on Kinematics Graph Reading
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can recognize graph features yet award credit without sufficient graphical support. This exploratory study examines selected grading outputs for synthetic responses to four kinematics exercises, generated through visual distortion and progressive transformation toward reference graphs. Different model and prompt configurations were used. Some judgments correctly distinguished instantaneous zero velocity from rest over a finite interval and recognized positive curvature. Yet a severely distorted velocity--time graph received full credit despite disconnected and branching traces and an unclear zero-velocity reference. Other submissions graded under the same configuration lost substantial credit. Numerical cutoffs intended to distinguish meaningful features from drawing irregularities were supplied without a coordinate convention for unnumbered graphs, leaving the basis of exact partial-credit awards unresolved. Stress testing can expose unsupported awards before classroom use. For the configurations examined, we do not recommend accepting scores as final grades without instructor review, including review of full-credit responses.

AI.tldr: 本研究探究了多模态大语言模型在运动学图表评分中缺乏足够图形支持即给分的问题，指出其评分需经教师审核后方可用于课堂。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在评估图表时可能在缺乏足够图形支持的情况下仍然给分的问题，以检验其评分可靠性。
AI.method: 这是一项探索性研究，通过对四个运动学题目的参考图进行视觉畸变和逐步转换生成合成作答，并在不同模型和提示词配置下测试模型的评分输出。
AI.result: 模型虽能正确区分部分图表特征，但一张严重畸变的速度-时间图（存在断线、分支及零速度参考不明确）仍获满分；此外，在缺乏坐标系约定时，部分扣分的具体依据不明确。
AI.conclusion: 压力测试可在课堂应用前暴露不合理的给分；因此，不建议在未经教师审查（包括对满分作答的审查）的情况下直接采用模型评分作为最终成绩。
